basis: x: PyPSA-Eur config.default.yaml transformers block, applied unconditionally in base_network.py. s_nom inferred: the 2000 MVA config value is a fallback never applied to transformers in the cited osm workflow (guarded by if "s_nom" not in transformers, and the prepared CSV always has the column); shipped as an assumed aggregate EHV bank capacity. r inferred from pandapower HV family vkr ~0.25%. Coupling: x_pu is per-unit on this s_nom, so at 400 kV X = 0.1*400^2/2000 = 8 ohm - low against a real 750 MVA SGT at 0.15 pu (~32 ohm); a convention choice, not an engineering value.

x from vk 12.2% (impedance magnitude; reactance correction <3e-5 pu), r from vkr 0.25%: pandapower standard type "160 MVA 380/110 kV", direct match for modal pair 110/380. s_nom inferred: assumed parallel banks. Review note: research proposed x=0.12/r=0.0025 for both R2 and R3; shipped values take each band exactly from its pandapower type (0.122/0.0025 and 0.120/0.0026) - deliberate change.
x from vk 12.0% (impedance magnitude), r from vkr 0.26%: pandapower standard type "100 MVA 220/110 kV", exact match for modal pair 110/220. s_nom inferred: assumed parallel banks.
x: PyPSA-Eur default. r,s_nom inferred: no standard type exists at these ratios; most pairs in this band with ratio <1.095 are probably voltage-tagging artefacts, flagged per row.
inferred: extrapolated from pandapower 110/20 kV family (vk 16.2%, vkr 0.34%); no two-winding standard type has a 50-100 kV LV side.

computed: ceil(max(total incident AC line s_nom at bus0, at bus1)) per PyPSA-Eur build_osm_network.py L1238-1248 - the convention the reference workflow actually ships (config s_nom=2000 is dead code for the osm base network). Deliberately non-binding; traction and internal-to-station layers excluded. WARNING: x_pu/r_pu are per-unit on s_nom_mva - mapping this column onto PyPSA s_nom while keeping x_pu rescales every impedance by the column ratio (median 5x, p95 20x, max 187x); recompute or drop x_pu if you swap.

selector: x,r are per-unit on the transformer own s_nom (PyPSA Transformer convention)
basis: PyPSA components doc + pypsa/data/component_attrs/transformers.csv. Sources pinned: pypsa-eur commit 8119040, pandapower tag v3.1.2 (vk/vkr per Oswald teaching text, not a TSO survey). PyPSA-Eur never sets transformer r (stays 0); this dataset departs deliberately and sources r from vkr.
